snippet.description:
Shubman Gill Press Conference: India Captain Discusses Batting Plans, Fitness and Hardik Pandya Ahead of 1st ODI vs New Zealand

Auckland: India captain Shubman Gill addressed the media ahead of the first ODI against New Zealand, scheduled for November 4 at Eden Park, Auckland. The Indian skipper discussed the team's batting combination, his fitness, Hardik Pandya's potential return and India's preparations for the upcoming ODI series.

With experienced batters Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli returning to the ODI setup, India will look to begin the series on a positive note against the Black Caps.

Shubman Gill Provides Fitness Update

Gill reassured fans about his fitness after concerns surrounding his neck. The Indian captain confirmed that he had completed his batting and fielding sessions without discomfort.

He explained that he had batted for nearly one and a half hours and completed his fielding drills without any trouble.

The update will be encouraging for India as Gill prepares to lead the team in the opening three matches of the ODI series.

India’s Batting Order: Gill Confirms Flexible Approach

Gill revealed that India's top four batting positions are settled, with the captain joined by Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli and Shreyas Iyer.

However, India will adopt a flexible approach to the No. 5 and No. 6 positions, depending on the match situation.

Gill explained that Axar Patel could be promoted if the team needs a left-handed batter in the middle order, while KL Rahul also remains an option for different batting positions.

This flexibility could help India respond to New Zealand's bowling strategies and maintain the right balance throughout the innings.

Gill Discusses Hardik Pandya’s Comeback

Hardik Pandya's absence was another important topic during the press conference. Gill highlighted the all-rounder's value to the Indian team and expressed hope that he would regain match fitness through domestic cricket.

Gill also revealed that Pandya had suffered a minor fitness setback before an India A match.

The Indian captain emphasised the importance of having a player capable of contributing with both bat and ball, particularly when finalising the team's lower-middle-order combination.

Pandya's eventual return could provide India with greater balance and additional options in both departments.

India vs New Zealand: Focus on a Strong Start

The opening ODI presents an important opportunity for India to establish momentum in the five-match series. With Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli bringing experience to the batting lineup, India will aim to build a strong foundation against New Zealand.

Playing at Eden Park will also test India's ability to adapt to local conditions and execute their plans under pressure.

For Gill, the series represents another opportunity to strengthen his leadership credentials while preparing India for future challenges in international cricket.

Shubman Gill's pre-match press conference provided important insights into India's batting strategy, his fitness and the team's plans for Hardik Pandya's return.

With the first ODI approaching, India will look to combine experience with tactical flexibility as they take on New Zealand in Auckland

snippet.description:
다음 키워드 '한국어'입니다. 

 미안해, 괜찮아 같은 우리말이 일본 젊은이들의 대화에서 자주 등장하고 있습니다.

 뉴욕타임스가 이런 현상을 집중 조명했습니다. 

 한 일본 음료 회사의 광고입니다.

 K팝에 맞춰 춤추던 아이들이 넘어지자 한국어로 "괜찮아"라고 말합니다.

 이 '괜찮아'라는 표현은 일본 고등학생들이 꼽은 유행어 3위에 오를 만큼 인기를 끌고 있는데요.

 '진짜', '미안해' 같은 말도 일상 대화에서 자주 쓰이고 있습니다.

 뉴욕타임스는  한국어와 일본어를 섞어 쓰는 이른바 '한본어'도  등장했다고 소개했는데요.

 일본어로 진짜를 뜻하는 '마지'에 한국어 '고마워'를 붙여 "마지 고마워"라고 표현하는 식입니다.

 두 언어의 발음 체계가 유사한 데다, 한국 콘텐츠의 인기가 더해지면서 한국어가  일본 젊은 세대의 언어생활에도 영향을 미치고 있다는 분석도  내놨습니다.

snippet.title: Laws Of Human Nature Summarized In 30 Minutes | Vaibhav Kadnar
snippet.description:
48 Laws Of Power - https://youtu.be/ERAsP5TMQso?si=LF2hxooOXGiZvk0Y

Read Body Language Like A PRO - https://youtu.be/ttykgdwhWAY?si=K7wZJNjsunIQIOyW

How to understand human psychology? How to read people better? How to control your emotions, identify hidden intentions, understand human behaviour and recognize the patterns people repeat in relationships, friendships, business and everyday life?

In this video, Vaibhav Kadnar explains The Laws of Human Nature by Robert Greene in simple Hinglish with practical examples and relatable situations.

The Laws of Human Nature is one of Robert Greene’s most detailed books on psychology, human behaviour, emotions, ego, relationships, character, influence, jealousy, self-awareness and the unconscious patterns that affect the way people think and act.

Most people believe they understand themselves and the people around them.

But human behaviour is rarely that simple.

People say one thing and do another. They make emotional decisions and later justify them with logic. They hide insecurity behind confidence. They repeat the same relationship, friendship and business patterns without realizing it.

And sometimes, the biggest blind spots are not in other people. They are inside us.

This video breaks down some of the most important ideas from Robert Greene’s The Laws of Human Nature and explains how you can observe behaviour more carefully, understand your own reactions better and make smarter decisions about the people around you.

In this video, you will learn:

How to understand human nature  
How to understand human psychology  
How to read people better  
How to understand human behaviour  
How emotions influence decisions  
How to become more self-aware  
How to identify repeated behaviour patterns  
How to understand someone’s true character  
How body language reveals emotions  
How to identify hidden intentions  
How to control impulsive decisions  
How ego affects behaviour  
How insecurity affects relationships  
How narcissism works  
How empathy improves relationships  
How people create social masks  
How habits reveal personality  
How to identify toxic behaviour patterns  
How to understand difficult people  
How to recognize manipulation  
How jealousy and envy work  
How desire affects human behaviour  
How short-term thinking affects decisions  
How to think long term  
How to make better life decisions  
How defensiveness works  
How to communicate with stubborn people  
How attitude affects your circumstances  
How negative thinking creates self-sabotage  
How unconscious beliefs influence behaviour  
How to understand darker emotions  
How to recognize psychological blind spots  
How to improve emotional intelligence  
How to understand relationships better  
How to judge people before trusting them  
How to understand people in business  
How to choose better friends and business partners  

Understanding psychology is not about becoming suspicious of everyone.

The real advantage comes from learning to notice patterns.

How does someone behave under pressure? How do they react when their ego is challenged? How do they treat people when they no longer need something from them?

And most importantly, what patterns do you repeatedly follow without noticing?

The video explores these questions through ideas from Robert Greene’s work while connecting them with relationships, friendships, business, social media, money and everyday decision making.

If you can learn to observe behaviour instead of simply believing words, you can understand people much more clearly.

And if you apply the same observation to yourself, you can become more aware of your own emotions, biases, insecurities and decision-making patterns.

This video is especially useful for students, entrepreneurs, creators, professionals and anyone interested in psychology, self-improvement, emotional intelligence, relationships and understanding people.
